query: Southeast Georgia EV supply chain tariff mitigation strategies

statements.text: Georgia has become the preferred location for firms in the emerging lithium-ion battery supply chain, including mining, materials processing, and manufacturing of battery cell components, modules, and packs.
Adding tariff clauses to supplier agreements is now standard practice for 45 percent of organizations.
To mitigate tariff exposure, 54 percent of respondents have diversified their supplier base, seeking new partners in lower-tariff regions.
Nearly half of respondents have enhanced supplier screening and assessed high-risk third parties.
